name: buildary
description: Make images, videos, ads and websites with Buildary from your agent: product photos, thumbnails, marketplace listing images, ads from a product link, UGC and product ads, image edits, Remakes, and websites built, changed and published on your request. Jobs over 20 credits wait for your approval of the price; website work starts only after you agree. Connects the Buildary MCP; sign in with your Buildary account.

interface.longDescription: Make images, videos, ads and websites with Buildary from Codex: product photos that keep the real product, Trendyol, Hepsiburada and Amazon TR listing images under each marketplace's rules, ads from a product page link, YouTube thumbnails, creator-style UGC ads, product films and feed ads with hook variants, focused image edits, Buildary Remakes that put your people or products into an existing video, and Buildary websites built, changed and published on your request. Every job runs on your Buildary credits: a job at or under 20 credits starts at once, a larger one waits for your approval of its price, a set is priced as one total first, and a retried request never charges twice. Website work is charged by use, so every build or change starts only after you agree, and a site goes live only when you ask.
